htzdistance.config.title: HtzDistance
htzdistance.config.enabled.description: Master switch, also toggled with the Toggle Mod key. Off, the mod does no work at all; stored holograms are kept.
htzdistance.config.kind.enabled.descript: Keep showing this entity type after the server stops sending it.
htzdistance.config.kind.threshold.descri: Horizontal distance (blocks) at which the server stops sending this entity type. Defaults match the measured server: 16 for armor stands, 8 for item frames and paintings.
htzdistance.config.thresholdMargin.descr: Tolerance around the tracking range. An entity removed closer than (range - margin) is treated as destroyed, not as out of range.
htzdistance.config.inRangeTimeoutSeconds: If you stay inside the real range this long and the entity does not come back, its hologram is removed.
htzdistance.config.reconcileRadius.descr: Max distance between a hologram and a returning real entity to treat them as the same one.
htzdistance.config.learningMode.descript: Measures the real disappearance distance of each type while you play and uses it instead of the values above.
htzdistance.config.maxRenderDistance.des: Holograms farther than this (blocks) are not drawn.
htzdistance.config.maxHolograms.descript: Max number of holograms kept per dimension. The farthest ones are dropped first.
htzdistance.config.occlusionCulling.desc: Skip holograms hidden behind blocks, checked asynchronously on a background thread.
htzdistance.config.reuseRenderStates.des: Draws holograms with a render state kept across frames (refreshed every second). Much faster with many holograms on Minecraft 1.21.10 and later. Turn it off if a mod draws holograms incorrectly.
htzdistance.config.hologramStyle.descrip: How holograms look compared to real entities. Tinted: as if seen through tinted glass. Translucent: you can see through them.
htzdistance.config.tintColor.description: Color of the tinted glass with the Tinted style.
htzdistance.config.tintOpacity.descripti: How strong the tint of the Tinted style is: low values keep the real colors, 100% filters them fully through the tint color.
htzdistance.config.translucentAlpha.desc: Opacity of holograms with the Translucent style.
htzdistance.config.glowing.description: Draws a glowing outline around holograms, like the Glowing effect, with any style. Minecraft 1.21.10 and later.
htzdistance.config.persistence.descripti: Keep holograms between sessions, stored per server and dimension.
htzdistance.config.debugLogging.descript: Log every capture, drop and reconciliation to the game log.
htzdistance.config.group.learned.descrip: Ranges measured on the server you are connected to. Used instead of the configured ones when learning mode is on.
htzdistance.config.learned.noServer: Join a server or world to see its learned ranges.
htzdistance.config.learned.notEnough: not enough data (%s removals, %s additions, need %s each)
htzdistance.config.learned.reset.descrip: Deletes the samples learned on this server. Reopen the screen to refresh the values.
htzdistance.message.cleared: HtzDistance: removed %s holograms in this dimension
htzdistance.message.clearedAll: HtzDistance: removed %s holograms and the saved holograms of every dimension of this server
htzdistance.message.config.reset: HtzDistance: config reset to the defaults
htzdistance.message.noConfigScreen: HtzDistance: the config screen needs YACL. Use /htzdistance config or edit config/htzdistance.json.
